The tx_ack actual is 5 which matches my hand count at the bottom of the test: ack to r0 after first data (1), acks to r1,r2,r3 on their data (3), then stale data re-acks r0 (1) = 5. My check expression expected 7 — my mistake in the test, not the implementation. Let me recount carefully:

Events:
1. data r0 p0 → accept. Mode 3 → E[0]=1>U[0]=0 → upstream ACK to r0. tx_ack=1.
2. data r0 p1 → blocked (p=1 ≥ b+N=0+1=1). Service: nothing pending (E[0]=1=U[0], no repeat since blocked doesn't set repeat). tx_ack stays.
3. data r1 p0 → accept → ACK to r1. tx_ack=2.
4. data r2 p0 → ACK r2 → 3.
5. data r3 p0 → ACK r3 → 4. Also slot complete → results to 0..3 → tx_data=4.
6-9. ack r0..r3 upto 1 → effective each (sent=1). No new upstream ACKs (E=U=1). Retire after r3's ack... actually retireable needs all four ackd>0 and U>0 — after 4th ack (r3): b→1... wait retire happens incrementally: after ack r0: ackd[0]=1 but ackd[1..3]=0 → no. After ack r3 (4th): all ackd=1, U=[1,1,1,1] → b=1. But note retirement only completes after ALL four acks — the order r0..r3 ✓. But actually retireable(0) after ack r3? outs_acked(0) = all ackd[d]>0 ✓ U[r]>0 ✓ → b=1. Note b advances only when all conditions hold — after ack r3. But careful: acks arrive one per event; after ack r3's service, retire runs → b=1 ✓.

Hmm wait — but actually ackd ordering: ack r0 upto1 → ackd[0]=1; retire needs all ackd[d]>0 → not yet. ack r1, r2 → still ackd[3]=0. ack r3 → b=1 ✓.
10. snap 'post' → state at that point: b=1 ✓ etc.
11. data r0 p0 → stale (p=0<b=1) → stale=1, repeat[0]=true → service: E[0]=1>0, E==U but repeat → upstream ACK to r0 → tx_ack=5.

So tx_ack=5 ✓ and my test's expectation of 7 was wrong (I wrote 7 hastily). The implementation is right. Also t2 'post' snapshot values passed via state checks at end (same).

Also check the snapshot 'post' contents — the state at snap has b=1... wait, snap occurs after all 4 acks → b=1 ✓ matches final st since stale data doesn't change b. But occupied at snap = 0 ✓.

Let me fix the hand test expectation to 5 and also verify trace contents for t2: trace should have: ACK r0, ACK r1, ACK r2, ACK r3 (from data events), then 4 result frames... wait order: on data r3 (event 5): service → phase 1: ACK to r3 (pending), phase 3: results to 0..3. So trace order: [ack0, ack1, ack2, ack3, res0, res1, res2, res3, ack0(stale repeat)] = 9 emissions. tx_data=4, tx_ack=5 ✓ total 9 frames. bytes = 9*62 = 558.

Let me also verify wire frame content of the stale-repeat ACK: E=1 → psn = start+1-1 = 0 → body 0x1f000001. Same as the first ACK to r0 ✓ (repeat of eligible ACK).

Let me update the test and add more hand tests: gather q mapping (check emitted PSNs), reducescatter mapping, barrier, broadcast nonroot invalid, future/zero/stale ACKs, budget failure counting, retry retransmission order and content, trace sampling.

content.text: The implementation gives tx_ack=5, which matches my manual event-by-event count (1+3 from data, 1 from stale repeat) — the test constant 7 was my arithmetic error. Fixing the test and adding deeper hand checks on trace contents, retry, budget and mapping:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
src=open('handtest.py').read()
src=src.replace("check('t2 tx', (st[20],st[21]),(4,7))   # 4 results; 4 initial acks + r1..r3? see below",
"check('t2 tx', (st[20],st[21]),(4,5))   # 4 results; acks: r0,r1,r2,r3 + stale repeat r0")
open('handtest.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cat >> /workspace/handtest.py <<'EOF'

# ---- Test 3: trace order and frame bytes (mode 3 allreduce, order check) ----
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[v]} for r,v in enumerate([1,2,3,4])]
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,
      'capacity':1,'start':5,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
# expected order: ack0 ack1 ack2 ack3 (data services), then res0 res1 res2 res3 on 4th data
frames=[t['hex'] for t in out['trace']]
exp_first4=[bytes((2,0,0,0,0,r+1)).hex()+bytes((2,1,0,0,0,r+1)).hex() for r in range(4)]
check('t3 trace ranks', [t['rank'] for t in out['trace']],[0,1,2,3,0,1,2,3])
# result frame to rank d: psn=start+0=5, payload sum=10 -> 0000000a (D=1 here sum=10)
check('t3 result psn d0', frames[4][100:108],'80000005')
check('t3 result payload d0', frames[4][108:116],'0000000a')
# upstream ack to rank r: psn = start+E-1 = 5
check('t3 ack psn r0', frames[0][100:108],'00000005')
check('t3 ack body r0', frames[0][108:116],'1f000006')
check('t3 packets', (out['packets'],out['bytes']),(8,8*62))

# ---- Test 4: gather q mapping and emission order ----
# allgather K=2 D=1 N=4 mode 3: feed r3 p1 first (out of order), then others.
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':3,'p':1,'values':[9]}]
for r in range(4):
    ev.append({'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[10+r]})
for r in range(4):
    ev.append({'op':'data','rank':r,'p':1,'values':[20+r]})
case={'primitive':'allgather','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':2,'words':1,
      'capacity':4,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
st=out['state']
check('t4 sent', st[6:10],[6,6,6,6])
check('t4 R', st[2:6],[2,2,2,2])
check('t4 accepted', st[22],8)
check('t4 b', st[0],0)     # no downstream acks -> nothing retires
frames=[t['hex'] for t in out['trace']]
# after all p=0 contributions: records q=0..2 for each d (p=0 complete). p=1 incomplete at
# that time except r3's contribution. new results per d in ascending q: q=0,1,2 for d=0..3
# psn = q (start=0). Check destination frames: for d, q=3p+ord(d,s).
# d=0: q0 <- s=1 (10+1=11), q1 <- s=2 (12), q2 <- s=3 (9 from p=1? no! q2 belongs to p=0,s=3 -> 13)
check('t4 d0 q0 payload', frames[4][108:116],'0000000b')   # s=1 value 11
check('t4 d0 q1 payload', frames[5][108:116],'0000000c')   # s=2 value 12
check('t4 d0 q2 payload', frames[6][108:116],'0000000d')   # s=3 value 13
check('t4 d0 q0 psn', frames[4][100:108],'80000000')
check('t4 d0 q2 psn', frames[6][100:108],'80000002')

# ---- Test 5: reducescatter mapping ----
# K=4 block=1: p maps to dest=p, q=0 always. result payload = sum at p.
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':2,'values':[r*100]} for r in range(4)]
case={'primitive':'reducescatter','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':4,'words':1,
      'capacity':4,'start':7,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
frames=[t['hex'] for t in out['trace']]
# only destination 2 gets a result at q=0 -> psn 7; sum=0+100+200+300=600=0x258
check('t5 dest frames', [t['rank'] for t in out['trace'] if int(t['hex'][100:108],16)&0x80000000],[2])
check('t5 payload', frames[-1][108:116],'00000258')
check('t5 psn', frames[-1][100:108],'80000007')
st=out['state']
check('t5 sent', st[6:10],[0,0,1,0])

# ---- Test 6: barrier empty payloads ----
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
case={'primitive':'barrier','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':0,
      'capacity':1,'start':3,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
frames=[t['hex'] for t in out['trace']]
check('t6 sizes', (out['packets'],out['bytes']),(8,8*58))
check('t6 result frame len', len(frames[4]),116)  # 58 bytes hex
check('t6 result psn', frames[4][100:108],'80000003')
check('t6 ack body r0', frames[0][108:116],'1f000004')

# ---- Test 7: broadcast: nonroot data endpoint-invalid; root only source ----
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':1,'p':0,'values':[5]},   # endpoint-invalid
    {'op':'data','rank':2,'p':0,'values':[6]},   # root accepts (root=2)
    {'op':'data','rank':2,'p':0,'values':[6]},   # duplicate -> repeat ack
    {'op':'ack','rank':2,'upto':1}]              # nonreceiver ack -> ignored
case={'primitive':'broadcast','mode':3,'root':2,'segments':1,'words':1,
      'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
st=out['state']
check('t7 classes', (st[18],st[19],st[22],st[23],st[26],st[27],st[28]),(2,1,1,1,0,1,1))
check('t7 U', st[14:18],[0,0,1,0])
check('t7 sent', st[6:10],[1,0,0,1])   # nonroots 0,1,3 get result; root=2 none
# emissions: ack r2 (accept), result d0,d1,d3, ack r2 (dup repeat), ...
ranks=[t['rank'] for t in out['trace']]
check('t7 first emissions', ranks[:5],[2,0,1,3,2])

# ---- Test 8: budget failure counting + retry retransmission ----
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[1]} for r in range(4)]
ev+=[{'op':'ack','rank':r,'upto':1} for r in range(4)]   # acks -> results unacked forever
ev+=[{'op':'budget','n':0},{'op':'flush'},               # flush attempt fails
     {'op':'budget','n':1},{'op':'retry','rank':3}]      # 1 emission allowed: upstream ack? none pending
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,
      'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
st=out['state']
# results already sent+acked... wait: ack upto=1 acks q=0 for each -> results acknowledged
check('t8 failed', st[29],1)     # flush with budget 0: pending retransmit? retry rank3 sent-unacked? none
print('   (t8 detail: ackd',st[10:14],'sent',st[6:10],'failed',st[29],'tx',st[20],st[21],')')
EOF
python3 /workspace/handtest.py
